name: @olai/server
//main: src/serve.ts, not src/main.ts: main.ts ends in a top-level run that starts the server and installs signal handlers, so a resolver honouring `main` over `exports` would boot a listener on import. The binary is reached as a script path (default.nix, the justfile), never as a module.
//dependencies:
The composition root: it is the only package allowed to know about all of the others, and the direction is strictly downward (docs/architecture.md). @olai/identity is the person on the request, as a value — this package is the HTTP door over it, not the parse. @olai/state is where this machine keeps olai's own files — the runtime home the one-brain lock claims in and the state home a remembered git policy lives in, neither of them inside the vault. @olai/web is deliberately absent — the server serves a built bundle it is handed, it does not import the client.

@olai/plugin-api is HOW THIS PACKAGE MEETS AN APPLIANCE, and the two appliance clients this list used to carry are gone because of it: they were here so runtime.ts could call an appliance's own half-constructor and hold a named slot per appliance on its Wiring, and both calls live behind the plugin wall now, in the package that owns the judgement. No source here imports either. No PLUGIN is named here either, and cannot be: packages/bundle/src/fence.test.ts holds every package outside @olai/plugin-api to an EMPTY list of plugin specifiers, in its manifest as much as in its sources. Which door of @olai/plugin-api a consumer opens is the graph decision that package's own manifest argues — this one opens ./server for the runtime halves and ./wire for the composition helpers, and never the root, because the manifests carry a plugin's browser faces.
//acp: The ACP SDK is NOT here: talking to an agent is @olai/chat's, and this package composes it. What is left of the agent in this file is a workspace dependency and one call.
//ws: Not here any more, and that is the point of serveSurfaceApp: no source in this package names a websocket implementation. `ws` is the hydrated @kolu/surface-app's own peer dependency, declared at the ROOT with the rest of them (bunfig.toml has the argument).
//devDependencies: @olai/child is the subprocess socket the process-boundary tests ride (`child.testlib.ts`, `surfaceCli.test.ts`); product spawn is `@olai/chat`'s and `@olai/git`'s. Deliberately not a runtime dependency: nothing in the served binary imports it.
